name: NOSi Data Center (Praia)
developer: NOSi – Núcleo Operacional da Sociedade de Informação, EPE (Cabo Verde government IT agency); supported by African Development Bank
notes: Government multi-tenant hybrid-cloud data center in Praia (Santiago Island, Sotavento), located <2km from the Cabo Verde Technology Park. NOSi founded 1998 to protect and use state data; operates a hybrid cloud data center; AfDB-backed and referenced in official AfDB coverage of Cabo Verde's regional-ICT-hub push. Hosts the SVOM CPV2 space-ground-station equipment (since Aug 2020). An emergency power station for the NOSi data center was built as part of Cabo Verde Technology Park construction works (WinPower). Capacity in MW not publicly disclosed.

name: Cabo Verde Technology Park – Praia Campus Data Center (TechPark CV)
developer: Government of Cabo Verde / TechPark CV Agency (executed by NOSi); financed by African Development Bank (loans ~€45.5M covering phases I & II)
notes: Tier-III-equivalent data center within the 8-hectare Cabo Verde Technology Park (TechPark CV) in Praia (Santiago Island), part of a business/incubation/training campus (~€51.85M total investment). Phase-1 construction 85% complete by Sep 2022 and due end-2022; park began operations Nov 2023 and was officially inaugurated May 5, 2025, hosting 23 companies from 7 countries with 300+ staff. Solar PV designed to cut energy costs 30-40%; Microsoft, Huawei and Intel engaged; ZEET special economic zone (2.5% CIT). A second data center plus a disaster-recovery site was planned under the 2023 phase-2 €14M AfDB loan. Praia is the landing point for EllaLink, WACS, SHARE and domestic subsea cables. Capacity in MW not publicly disclosed.

name: Cabo Verde Technology Park – Mindelo Campus Disaster-Recovery Data Center (TechPark CV)
developer: Government of Cabo Verde / TechPark CV Agency (executed by NOSi); financed by African Development Bank (phase-2 €14M loan signed Aug 2023)
notes: Second TechPark CV campus in Mindelo (São Vicente Island) hosting a disaster-recovery/secondary data center for business continuity of the national network, plus a blue-economy innovation hub. The DR site was announced under phase-2 (Aug 2023 €14M AfDB loan); campus officially inaugurated May 6, 2025, alongside the Praia campus. Facility scale/capacity not publicly disclosed; status based mainly on trade press (DCD), IFC country diagnostic and third-party park profile (C-grade detail) – no separate data-center activity identified on other Barlavento islands (Sal, Boa Vista, Santo Antão, São Nicolau).
